_comment: Two separate facts, deliberately not one field. 'translated' lists pages whose copy is finished; that turns ON the quality checks (leftover-English scan, blog-title agreement). 'live' lists language trees that are actually published; that turns OFF noindex and puts pages into sitemap.xml, the hreflang sets and the language switcher. A tree can be fully translated and still not live, which is exactly where everything sits until a native speaker has proofread it. See .build/cutover.md.
